name: Gästehaus Fuchs
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Fuchs is located in the region of Tirol in Österreich. The accommodation is classified as a hotel and offers a quiet atmosphere. Guests can expect friendly service. The surroundings are characterized by the Alpen landscape. Hiking is possible directly from the house. The rooms are functionally furnished. The facilities offer basic amenities. A stay in this area is relaxing.
